recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Future work is only needed if the work group decides to replace the external methodology link with ballot-controlled normative text or to add validator warnings in a separate decision.
issue_request: FHIR-28222 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I request to document naming/casing rules for custom OperationDefinition.code values, originally suggesting warning invariants for non-conforming codes. The final resolution was to link from the OperationDefinition page, especially the code element, to the HL7 Guide to Designing Resources naming rules and not implement invariants at this point.
initial_application: Historical commit f66495934d6e14ff49960225f34dad67af323c298 explicitly applied FHIR-28222 by adding an OperationDefinition Code narrative section and updating the OperationDefinition.code element comment with the Confluence Naming Rules & Guidelines link. OperationDefinition is actively listed in source/fhir.ini, so these files are current build-scope source.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes for 2020-11-09 record the 9-0-1 Persuasive with Modification motion to create a link to Confluence naming guidelines and not update invariants. The Zulip thread linked from the Jira shows the original OperationDefinition.code casing question and later explains that documentation links were preferred because constraints would be brittle or spuriously noisy; the discussion also clarified that the Confluence rules are internal HL7 authoring guidance, not binding rules for every implementer.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current OperationDefinition.code comment contains the requested naming-guidelines link, the OperationDefinition narrative includes matching guidance, and no OperationDefinition.code naming/casing invariant has been introduced.
